> **Heads up**: open-ended questions and design ideas are usually better in [Discussions](https://github.com/shizukutanaka/yagura/discussions). Use this template only if you believe the question warrants tracking as an Issue.

## What are you trying to do?

A concise description of the goal. What would success look like?

## What did you try?

Commands, configuration, code snippets. Please include the full output of `--version`:

```
$ yagura --version
yagura X.Y.Z (goX.Y.Z)
```

## Where did you get stuck?

The specific error message, unexpected output, or behavior gap. Paste verbatim.

## Environment

- OS:
- yagura version:
- Go version (if built from source):
- Connected MCP client(s):

## Anything else?

Links, screenshots, or context that might help.
